Pocket and corner legend (slice S3)

What changes: only the colour legend under the 3D view, the verdict line and the finding rows. The layout is the approved S2 screen.

  • Two new legend rows, "Pockets checked, no finding" (purple) and "Corners checked, no finding" (teal), each with its own checkbox. All three boxes start on, as holes do now (D-014).
  • A corner fillet is part of its pocket too, so the corner colour wins there.
  • The verdict line names only the kinds the part has. A holes-only part still reads "2 holes checked".
  • Pocket and corner findings show depth, radius and the end mill that fits.
  • The legend always lists all three kinds, even when the part has none of one, so it reads the same on every part (my default; say if you want absent kinds hidden).
  • Every finding carries its "F1 MEDIUM" label on its faces, as in S2. F1 and F4 are the two front corners, hidden behind the front rim at this angle, so their labels sit on the rim edge above them.

Version 2: every picture is the real 3D viewer with the new legend built in (on the S3 branch, not merged), on the real test parts. Version 1 used a hand-drawn sketch.

Normal: clean_pocket, nothing flagged, 1280 px

0.150 in corners, 0.400 in deep. The 1/4 in end mill fits (1.6×). The pocket is purple and its corner fillets teal.

Alert: pocket_long_thin_tool, 5 findings, 1280 px

0.050 in corners, 0.500 in deep. Only the 3/32 in end mill fits the corners (5.3× deep). Faces with a finding show their severity colour and an "F1 MEDIUM" label, not the checked tints.

Island: pocket_island, 1 finding

The 0.200 in gap beside the island limits the tool to 3/16 in (3.2× deep). The island top stays grey: it is not part of the pocket.

Real part: daratech.stp (NIST STEP/STI set)

7 holes, 7 pockets and 30 corners checked. Deep ribbed pockets (2.697 in) give 23 medium findings. Labels crowd where findings cluster, as they already do on S2 hole parts.

Below 900 px: fillet_not_hole at 880 px

Selected (version 3)

Clicking a finding turns its faces the Selected blue, fades the rest and turns the camera to them, as in S2. Two changes for pockets, both after looking at version 2 selected:

  • The camera never zooms in tighter than 40% of the part's size. A corner fillet alone used to fill the screen, so you lost sight of where it was.
  • A sharp corner has no face of its own, so it is drawn as a bar along the corner edge, in its severity colour, and blue when selected. Before, its two whole walls were painted, which read as "these walls" rather than "this corner".

Corner fillet selected: pocket_long_thin_tool, F1

Whole pocket selected: pocket_long_thin_tool, F5

Sharp corners, nothing selected: pocket_sharp

Sharp corner selected: pocket_sharp, F1
